tags.label: Removal
tags.description: Destroys, exiles, or otherwise answers an opposing creature or permanent.

tags.label: Burn
tags.description: Deals direct damage to creatures or players.

tags.label: Draw
tags.description: Draws extra cards or digs for them.

tags.label: Ramp
tags.description: Makes extra mana or fetches lands.

tags.label: Evasion
tags.description: Hard to block, or makes other creatures hard to block.

tags.label: Finisher
tags.description: A big threat that can close out a game.

tags.label: Control
tags.description: Counters, taps, freezes, bounces, or strips the opponent's hand.

tags.label: Pump
tags.description: Makes creatures bigger for a turn or for good.

tags.label: Protection
tags.description: Keeps creatures or other permanents safe.

tags.label: Tokens
tags.description: Makes tokens or rewards having them.
Puts +1/+1 counters on creatures or rewards them.
Puts -1/-1 counters on creatures or rewards them.

tags.label: Lifegain
tags.description: Gains life or rewards gaining it.

tags.label: Sacrifice
tags.description: Sacrifices your own permanents for value, or pays off when they die.

tags.label: Graveyard
tags.description: Brings cards back or uses what is in the graveyard.

tags.label: Mill
tags.description: Puts cards from the opponent's library into the graveyard.

tags.label: Tutor
tags.description: Searches the library for a specific card.

tags.label: Blink
tags.description: Exiles a permanent and returns it to replay its enter effect.

tags.label: Artifacts
tags.description: An artifact, or a card that cares about artifacts.

tags.label: Auras
tags.description: Auras and equipment, or cards that reward attaching them.

tags.label: Spells
tags.description: Instants and sorceries, or cards that trigger when you cast them.
